question: Which of the following is an asset that the borrower owns (such as land, building, vehicle, livestocks, deposits with banks) and uses this as a guarantee to a lender until the loan is repaid?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Collateral **is an asset that the borrower owns (**such as land, building, vehicle, livestocks, deposits with banks**) and uses this as a guarantee to a lender until the loan is repaid.
 
• Things kept as a guarantee with the moneylender for taking a loan are known as Collateral.
 
• It is used as a way to obtain a loan, acting as a protection against potential loss for the lender should the borrower default.
 
• It is simply an asset, such as a car or home, that a borrower offers up as a way to qualify for a** particular loan**.
 
• It can make a lender more **comfortable extending **the loan since it protects their financial stake if the borrower ultimately fails to repay the **loan in full**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Loans from Informal Lender** –** Collateral **not Required. It is easier to get loans from informal lenders.
 
• **Collateral **would not be required when taking loans from informal lenders.
 
• Here, the borrower may know the informal lender personally.
 
• **Loans from Banks – Collateral** is RequiredUsually poor people may not have sufficient collateral to get loans from the banks. Banks loans need collateral (security) against loans.
 
• It is very difficult for poor people to borrow from banks when compared to borrowing money from informal sources.
 
• Bank loans require proper documentation.
